notes: v619 — THE ACTUAL ROOT CAUSE, FINALLY. Four straight fixes (v614, v616, v617, v618) all targeted 'outline' and every single one had zero visible effect — which, in hindsight, was itself the real clue: it was never an outline. The table had NO protection against ordinary browser text-selection, unlike several other interactive elements in the app that already had it. A drag across the row — even a small one — selects whatever text falls in its path, producing exactly the band you kept showing, and is controlled by a completely different mechanism than outline, which is exactly why nothing else touched it. Your own word for it — 'selected' — was the answer both times. Text-selection is now disabled on the table entirely. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
